# A command step whose code is in stop_on_rc ends the item. obee run prints the step, the code and the output, and exits with code 1. obee status shows the stop.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

subst config/projects/local.star

exec obeereal item add local stop-it --title 'Stop it' --body-file body.txt

exitcode 1 obeereal run stop-it local --workflow flow/stop.star
stdout 'item stop-it stopped at step command:probe#1 with exit code 128'
! stdout 'finished'
! stdout 'after'

exec obeereal status
stdout 'stop-it-r1\tstopped\tstopped at command:probe#1 rc 128'

-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- body.txt --
Stop at the probe.
-- config/projects/local.star --
project(
    source      = "@WORK@/origin",
    base_branch = "main",
    gate        = "true",
)
-- flow/stop.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "probe", run = ["git", "rev-parse", "--verify", "refs/heads/nope"], stop_on_rc = [128])
    command(name = "after", run = ["git", "--version"])
